items.statement: Dispose of sewage, trash and other refuse from the building and its immediate surroundings safely and hygienically.
items.quote: Sewage, trash, and other refuse in and from the building and immediate premises shall be disposed of in a safe and sanitary manner.

items.statement: Provide adequate hand-washing facilities with hot and cold water, soap or detergent, air dryers or single-use towels, and clean toilets that are easy to reach from working areas.
items.quote: Adequate washing facilities shall be provided, including hot and cold water, soap or detergent, air driers or single-service towels, and clean toilet facilities easily accesible to working areas.

items.statement: Keep every building used to manufacture, process, pack or hold drug products clean and sanitary.
items.quote: Any building used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall be maintained in a clean and sanitary condition

items.statement: Keep every building used to manufacture, process, pack or hold drug products free of rodents, birds, insects and other vermin, other than laboratory animals.
items.quote: Any such building shall be free of infestation by rodents, birds, insects, and other vermin (other than laboratory animals).

items.statement: Hold and dispose of trash and organic waste promptly and hygienically.
items.quote: Trash and organic waste matter shall be held and disposed of in a timely and sanitary manner.

items.statement: Have written sanitation procedures that assign responsibility for sanitation and describe in enough detail the cleaning schedules, methods, equipment and materials used to clean buildings and facilities.
items.quote: There shall be written procedures assigning responsibility for sanitation and describing in sufficient detail the cleaning schedules, methods, equipment, and materials to be used in cleaning the buildings and facilities

items.statement: Follow the written sanitation and building cleaning procedures.
items.quote: such written procedures shall be followed.

items.statement: Have written procedures for the use of suitable rodenticides, insecticides, fungicides, fumigants, and cleaning and sanitizing agents.
items.quote: There shall be written procedures for use of suitable rodenticides, insecticides, fungicides, fumigating agents, and cleaning and sanitizing agents.

items.statement: Design the procedures for pest control and cleaning or sanitizing agents so they prevent contamination of equipment, components, containers, closures, packaging, labeling materials and drug products.
items.quote: Such written procedures shall be designed to prevent the contamination of equipment, components, drug product containers, closures, packaging, labeling materials, or drug products

items.statement: Follow the written procedures for the use of pest control, fumigating, cleaning and sanitizing agents.
Use rodenticides, insecticides and fungicides only if they are registered and used as required by the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (7 U.S.C. 135).
items.quote: Rodenticides, insecticides, and fungicides shall not be used unless registered and used in accordance with the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (7 U.S.C. 135).
items.condition: unless registered and used per the federal pesticide act

items.statement: Apply sanitation procedures to work done by contractors and temporary staff as well as to work done by full-time employees in normal operations.
items.quote: Sanitation procedures shall apply to work performed by contractors or temporary employees as well as work performed by full-time employees during the ordinary course of operations.

items.statement: Keep every building used to manufacture, process, pack or hold drug products in good repair.
items.quote: Any building used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall be maintained in a good state of repair.

items.statement: Ensure equipment used to manufacture, process, pack or hold drug products is of appropriate design and adequate size, and is located so that it supports its intended operations, cleaning and maintenance.
items.quote: Equipment used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product shall be of appropriate design, adequate size, and suitably located to facilitate operations for its intended use and for its cleaning and maintenance.
